name: Booster K1
price_note: reported launch price; retail listings vary widely by configuration
summary: Booster's entry-level classroom and competition humanoid, sold assembled and programmable through ROS and Python. It sits below the T-series as the cheap way into RoboCup-style humanoid soccer and embodied-AI coursework, with a depth camera, 9-axis IMU and microphone array on board.
notable: Built for RoboCup-style humanoid soccer teams
Ships assembled with an open SDK
